description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Capture, which manages capture buffers, callback registration, and rendering states for Smarty templating engine's runtime extension. It handles starting, closing, and error-checking for template capture sections, and manages internal buffers and callback functions.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Capture
classes.description: A class to handle capture sections, buffer management, and callback registration within Smarty's runtime environment.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initiates a capture section, registers callbacks if necessary, and starts output buffering.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers start and end render callbacks in the template object and initiates the first render callback.

methods.name: startRender
methods.description: Prepares for a new render cycle by saving current capture count and resetting it.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes a capture section, assigns the captured buffer to a variable or appends it, and manages buffer cleanup.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles errors related to mismatched capture blocks by throwing an exception.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of a named buffer or all buffers if no name is provided.

methods.name: endRender
methods.description: Ends the current render cycle, restoring previous capture count or throwing an error if capture is inconsistent.
